description: Actions are Dependabot's; this covers what Dependabot cannot see. platformCommit routes commits through the GitHub API so they carry GitHub's signature, which main's required_signatures rejects them without.

packageRules.description: Two managers see the pixi image and would each propose the same bump. The dockerfile manager reads the tag as one value, 0.77.1-noble, because it is built from two interpolated args; writing that back into ARG PIXI_VERSION would produce pixi:0.78.0-noble-noble. The regex manager owns the arg and writes only the version, so it is the one kept.

customManagers.description: PIXI_VERSION is an ARG. The dockerfile manager also sees the image, but reads the tag as a single combined value; this one writes the version alone, and the rule above disables the other.
